subject: POC trial: model selection, success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:21:00Z
Subject: POC trial: model selection, success criteria & next steps

Thanks again for a productive call today — great to learn more about Acme's storefront search and post-purchase support use cases. As promised, here’s a concise recap and proposed plan for the 2-week POC/trial so we can get to a meaningful evaluation quickly.

Summary of scope
- Primary focus: customer support triage + answer generation for post-purchase queries (returns, tracking, policy) and improving search relevancy for category pages.
- Languages: English primary; we will validate Spanish and French for the initial pass. You mentioned potential Turkish support later — we’ll scope that if needed after week 1.

Proposed success criteria (to be measured against your labeled eval set)
- Intent classification accuracy >= 90% (macro-averaged on support intents)
- Helpful/accurate answer rate >= 85% (human-rated on a 3-point scale)
- Hallucination rate <= 5% on fact-based queries
- Latency: p95 < 400ms for typical 256-token sequences (target)
- Cost: per-request token cost under your target (we’ll provide estimates once we finalize batching/quantization settings)

Model recommendation for the trial
- Primary model: Llama 2 13B-chat (quantized q4f16) — good balance of quality and cost for support/chat-style outputs.
- Fallback model: Mistral 7B Instruct (int8) — lower-latency, lower-cost option for routing under load or for cheap quick responses.
- Turkish / hard multilingual cases: we can evaluate MPT-30B-Instruct or an OpenAssistant 30B variant in parallel if Spanish/French results are weak; we won’t include that in the initial scope without sign-off.

Evaluation plan & ownership
- Data: Acme to provide ~200 labeled support queries (English) + ~50 per language for Spanish/French. Please anonymize PII.
- Metrics/evals: automated scoring on intents + blind human review for answer quality (you and Monica’s team).
- Roles: Marissa (sales owner, timeline/shopper), Aditya Rao (solutions/tech lead, sandbox & integration), Monica Patel (CS, evaluation coordinator).

Timeline (proposed)
- Nov 9: Kickoff + sandbox/API credentials handed off
- Nov 9–16: Integration, prompt templates, and initial tuning; weekly checkpoint Nov 16
- Nov 16–23: Blind eval, human review, and final results by Nov 23

Next steps (action items)
- Sarah: send the eval dataset (or sample) and confirm anonymization timeline
- Tom: confirm preferred kickoff time on Nov 9 (AM PST preferred by our team)
- Aditya: I’ll follow up with sandbox instructions and short runbook for integration (will attach sample prompts).

Attachments: POC_SOW_v1.pdf (scope & SOW), sample_prompts.csv (starter prompt templates + eval example rows).

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

—

- Dataset: we can have the 200 English labeled queries ready by Nov 6; Spanish and French will be smaller (~40–50 each) and available by Nov 8. We will remove customer PII prior to sharing.
- Multilingual performance: Spanish & French are must-haves for this POC; Turkish is lower priority but we’ll flag examples for later evaluation. If Llama 13B struggles, happy to try the alternative models you suggested.
- Sandbox/API: please provide sandbox keys and any rate limits we should expect. Also confirm whether the sandbox will simulate prefix caching/kv behavior for chat sessions.

Kickoff: Nov 9 works. Can we do 10:00 AM PST? That gives Tom and me time to join.

Thanks — Sarah
